The identifying facts are established (C1) and the record's severity classification has been located and is a recognized OSV/GHSA severity level.

E4 necessary (the version-range straddle is a fact disjoint from severity entirely -- a package can be high-severity for OTHER deployed versions while the one actually observed is outside the declared range, so E2/E3 alone cannot establish the version-specific exploitability verdict). Order-coherence by containment (C1's route subset of C2's, C2's subset of C3's).
